question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A hair in the butter
solution:
The correct answer is **'A challenging situation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'A hair in the butter' **is** 'A challenging situation'.**
 
• **A hair in the butter:** A problem or challenging situation. (एक समस्या या चुनौतीपूर्ण स्थिति)
 
 
• *Example: Forgetting my textbook at school has proved to be **a real hair in the butter **for my study plans.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *A challenging situation.*
